name: quarter-picker
purpose: Enter a calendar quarter (PlainYearQuarter; Q1 is January to March) in quarter and year segments ordered by a localizable pattern message, or pick one from a non-modal dialog popup with a row of the four quarters of a year (each showing its months, paged by year), with min/max bounds, unavailable quarters, localized validation, and native form submission as YYYY-Qn.
whenToUse: A calendar quarter: quarterly reports, targets, filings, or reviews.
Users should be able to type a quarter quickly and also see which months each quarter covers.
Quarter fields with bounds or unavailable quarters (for example quarters not yet closed).
whenNotToUse: Fiscal quarters of a year that does not start in January: the value and month hints are calendar quarters.
A month or a specific day: use Month Picker, Date Picker, or Date Input.
A whole year: use Year Picker.
A range of quarters: use two Quarter Pickers and a cross-field rule.
responsive: The group hugs its segments and the button, up to 100% of the container; segments wrap inside the group in very narrow containers. The popup is positioned under the group (bottom-start) by the positioning engine, is at most the viewport width minus a gutter, caps its height to the available space, and scrolls when taller. Density tokens adjust the control height.
rtl: Segment order and literals come from the localizable `pattern` message (English: `Q{quarter} {year}`). Segments render as an LTR-isolated run in every direction, and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight in segments follow that visual order (not mirrored). The button sits at the inline end of the group. The popup and grid take the resolved direction: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight in the grid are mirrored, the page chevrons are flipped, and the popup aligns to the inline start of the group.
theme: Control surface, border, focus, error, hover, selected, primary, and sunken-surface role tokens. The focused segment uses the selected pair; the selected quarter uses color-primary / color-on-primary; the current quarter is bold with an inset strong border; unavailable quarters are muted and struck through, so no state relies on color alone. The month hint uses font-size-xs and color-text-muted. Forced-colors mode uses Highlight for the focused segment and the selected quarter, a CanvasText outline for the current quarter, GrayText for disabled cells and buttons, and a CanvasText popup border.
timezone: Values are PlainYearQuarter (no timezone) and never shift. The configured timezone (default UTC, never the host zone) only decides the current quarter: the cell marked aria-current, the quarter focused when the popup opens on an empty field, and the starting year for ArrowUp/ArrowDown in an empty year segment. The advanced `today` option pins it to a fixed PlainDate.
security: Label, help text, segment names, cell text, month hints, headings, and messages are rendered with textContent and Intl formatting; no HTML parsing. Validation messages never include the entered value; range messages include only the formatted bounds. The popup uses the Popover API; no inline handlers. CSP-safe: positioning writes styles through the CSSOM.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. When `name` is set, a hidden input carries YYYY-Qn (for example 2026-Q3); it is empty while the entry is empty or fails a built-in check, and disabled (not submitted) while the picker is disabled. A read-only picker is submitted.

performance.testedScale: 100 instances per page in the performance test; the popup grid (4 cells) is created once per picker and re-rendered per page.

limitations: Calendar quarters only (Q1 is January to March); a fiscal-year start is not supported.
Only ASCII digits are accepted in segments; other characters are removed.
Segment order and literals come from the `pattern` message, not from Intl; locales without registered quarterPicker messages use the English pattern and labels.
Single quarters only; ranges need two pickers. The popup has no Cancel/OK buttons: picking commits.
Segment arrow navigation follows visual order and is not mirrored in RTL, because segments render as an LTR run.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
unsupported: Fiscal quarters or custom quarter-to-month mappings.
Rendering HTML in the label, help text, cells, or messages.
Custom cell content or a custom grid layout.
antiPatterns: Using a Quarter Picker for fiscal quarters that do not start in January; the month hints would be wrong.
Storing the displayed quarter text instead of the PlainYearQuarter or its YYYY-Qn form value.
Making the grid the only entry path; the segments stay available for keyboard and screen-reader users.
Relying on the host timezone for the current quarter; configure `timezone`.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/quarter-picker: AuiQuarterPicker directive ([auiQuarterPicker]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/quarter-picker: AuiQuarterPicker component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
